Application Data.NAME: ABC Realty Group
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Realty Group specializes in residential and commercial real estate transactions, including property management and leasing services. We assist clients in buying, selling, and renting properties, while ensuring compliance with local regulations and market trends. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and in-depth market analysis to help clients make informed decisions about their real estate investments.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2021, a minor slip and fall incident occurred at a rental property managed by ABC Realty Group, resulting in a claim of $5,000 for medical expenses. The claim was settled in November 2021 and is now closed. No further actions are pending.
